# Case, Map or Scroll (`equipment:case-map-or-scroll`)
**Categories:** [Adventuring Gear](../equipment-categories/adventuring-gear.md) | **Cost:** 1 gp | **Weight:** 1 lb.

A Map or Scroll Case holds up to 10 sheets of paper or 5 sheets of parchment.
